turns.text: Hello, this is the Sagility Smart Step Program offered by Allianz Life Insurance company . We are calling everyone who participated in the Smart Step program and would like to hear your feedback. Please call us back at 1-888-855-7837 between 8am and 8pm Eastern Time. You may also go online to take the survey at allianz.sagilitysmartsteps.com. That's a-l-l-i-a-n-z dot s-a-g-i-l-i-t-y-s-m-a-r-t-s-t-e-p-s dot com. Thank you.
turns.goal: Leave the program's voicemail message and end the call.

turns.text: Hello, this is Ida, your virtual assistant from the Sagility Smart Step program offered by Allianz Life Insurance company. May I speak to [policyholder's full name]?
turns.goal: Introduce yourself as Ida from the Smart Step program and ask to speak to the policyholder by name.

turns.text: Thank you for taking my call. We're calling everyone who participated in the Smart Step program to get your feedback and make the program even better. Do you have a couple of minutes for me to ask you a few questions?
turns.goal: Thank them for taking the call, say why you are calling, and ask whether they have a couple of minutes for a few questions.

turns.text: Would you like to reschedule the call for a better time?

turns.text: Please hold on and I will get you to someone to reschedule.

turns.text: Thank you for your time.
turns.goal: Thank them for their time and end the call.
